why: The model makes this **Miami by 10.8**; Vegas has **Miami by 13.5**. That's a **2.7-point** gap in Duke's favor.
Miami is the better team (#2 of 138 FBS overall vs. Duke at #24 of 138 FBS), but the model sees a smaller gap than the 13.5-point line implies.
Duke has played about 5 pts/game better over the last 3 weeks than its full-season rating.
It's a conference game, where home field is worth only about 0.6 pts, so playing on the road costs Duke less than usual.
The line has moved 7.5 pts toward Duke since it opened (Miami -21.0 → Miami -13.5), so bettors are agreeing with the model.
watch: The model only sees points, yards and home field. It knows nothing about injuries, weather or motivation.
